title: NHS Couch to 5K running plan (week-by-week)
population: General adult beginners; no outcome data
findings: 9 weeks, 3 runs a week with a rest day aimed for between runs; each run has a 5 min warm-up walk and a 5 min cool-down walk; the page says to speak to a GP first if worried about health.
Week 1 (all 3 runs): run 1 min / walk 1.5 min x 7, then run 1 min, i.e. 8 min of running (28.5 min total). Week 2: run 1.5 / walk 2 x 5, then run 1.5, i.e. 9 min of running (29 min total).
Week 3: run 1.5, walk 1.5, run 3, walk 3, run 1.5, walk 1.5, run 3 (9 min running, 25 min total). Week 4: run 3, walk 1.5, run 5, walk 2.5, run 3, walk 1.5, run 5 (16 min running, 31.5 min total).

Week 5: run 1 is 5/walk 3/5/walk 3/5 (31 min total); run 2 is 8/walk 5/8 (31 min); run 3 is the first continuous 20 min run (30 min total). Week 6: run 1 is 5/walk 3/8/walk 3/5 (34 min), run 2 is 10/walk 3/10 (33 min), run 3 is 25 min continuous (35 min).

Week 7 is 3 x 25 min continuous (35 min total); week 8 is 3 x 28 min continuous (38 min); week 9 is 3 x 30 min continuous (40 min). Week 5 text: if you need to repeat any of the runs or weeks, that's totally okay.
limitations: Convention (evidence level D): no outcome data on the page; the page shows published 24 Jun 2025 and modified 4 Sep 2026 in its metadata (year given is the modified year); the published plan is not evidence that run-walk beats 3 x 20 continuous.
implications: The mainstream run-walk start is 8 min of running in week 1, 9 min in weeks 2-3 and 16 min in week 4, with the first 20 min continuous run in week 5 (run 3), a 25 min run in week 6 and 3 x 25 min continuous only from week 7.
Weeks can be repeated: the page says repeating runs or weeks is fine, supporting a hold-or-repeat rule on the floor.
Use as a convention-level template (grade D) for the true novice path.

verification.notes: Re-fetched the NHS page this session and read weeks 1-9 from the HTML. Corrected two errors in the earlier record: (1) the quoted phrase 'or longer as you go through the plan' does not appear (the page says 'run further and for longer'), removed; (2) the implication claimed about 24-27 min of running time by week 4, but week 4 is 16 min of running (31.5 min is the session total). Added per-week running minutes. Page metadata: published 24 Jun 2025, modified 4 Sep 2026. Practice source (programme, coaching or clinical page): a published convention, not evidence; grade D.

interests: Public body; no commercial stake found. The page promotes the free NHS app and parkrun.
